messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty INCIDENT fired -> INC-8921: spike of 5xx errors from hosted-inference-us-west (customer-facing). Auto-attach: logs + recent deploys. Link: https://pd.example/INC-8921 :alarm_clock:
alex: picking this up, oncall-ack INC-8921 :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks alex. quick context? any deploys in the last 10m? :eyes:
incidentbot: deploybot detected a model weight rollout 4m ago to pool rw-west-2-gpu-3 by release/optimize-batching. Error summary: 5xx (502/504) mostly on /v1/stream and /v1/generate, ~35% of requests failing in last 5m. Logs attached to PD -> stack traces show grpc: upstream reset and kernel OOM hints.
kevin: re-checking metrics — kvcache eviction rate spiked and host mem pressure on node gw-05. Rolling restart of pool nodes? we can try draining gw-05 first. :thinking_face:
alex: timeline: if it's rollout-related, revert fast. maya, can you confirm if autoscaler triggered any scale-downs? julie, can you notify support to hold customer-facing notifications until we have impact numbers?
maya: autoscaler: no recent scale-downs; it was in a warm-up state. Batching change in release looks suspicious. Running quick grep in prod config:
```
# suspicious change excerpt
inference.batch.window_ms: 30 -> 10
inference.kv_cache.prefetch: true
```
maya: switching batch.window back to 30ms on the canary pool (rw-west-2-canary). Pushing patch now.
alex: while you do that i'll drain gw-05 and failover traffic to rw-west-2-b. Command:
```
./infra-cli drain-host --pool rw-west-2-gpu-3 --host gw-05 --reason "investigate 5xx"
```
kevin: drain started, moving active connections off gw-05, healthchecks will reroute. monitoring tail:
```
curl -sS https://metrics.internal/query?m=5xx_rate | jq .rate
```
julie: support notified on standby. Preparing a short blurb if customers ask: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors for hosted inference in US-WEST; on-call is working on a mitigation. We'll update within 15 minutes."
alex: canary patch applied to rw-west-2-canary, reverting batch.window to 30ms. Rolling canary check in 2 minutes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya: canary looks green after revert: 2m no errors on canary. Pushing patch to remaining pools with rolling restart strategy.
incidentbot: PD update: INC-8921 status -> acknowledged by alex. Incident priority: P1 -> PD escalation enabled.
kevin: after draining gw-05, node had multiple kernel restarts; looks like a driver-level oom during small-batch hot path. Metric trend shows token-per-request increased by ~20% for requests hitting the new batching path.
alex: action items so far: 1) revert batching config (in progress) 2) drain and isolate gw-05 (done) 3) rollback release to pre-optimize-batching tag on affected pools (in progress) 4) support notification prepared (julie)
julie: sending interim customer note now. Will post in #support-updates and hold for further update in 12m. :speech_balloon:
maya: rollback initiated for rw-west-2-gpu-3 -> rolling to pre-optimize-batching. Monitor health endpoints.
kevin: post-rollback health: 5xx rate trending down from 35% -> 6% in the last 4 minutes. Latency stable. I'll keep watch on kv cache evictions.
alex: good. set outage flag? customer impact: some requests timed out or errored for ~8 minutes, affecting ~12% of active customers in us-west. We should capture telemetry for the impacted window and attach to PD.
incidentbot: note added to INC-8921: "mitigation: rollback batching change; drained suspect host; rolling restart. Impact window ~2026-03-17T15:12Z -> 2026-03-17T15:20Z."
julie: support posted to customers impacted list. small set of enterprise customers pinged directly. Awaiting confirmation from eng before sending full postmortem ETA.
alex: once stable for 10m i'll handback to regular rotation. maya/kevin continue monitoring for another 20m and then confirm. :thumbsup:
maya: monitoring looks clean for 6m. kv eviction back to baseline. No new OOMs.
kevin: keeping alert thresholds tight for next 30m, will escalate if any regression.
alex: handing back to rotation: tagging oncall rotation bot — @oncall-rotation please reassign ownership back to next shift. Closing note: INC-8921 -> mitigation applied, monitoring, customer notifications sent. Will follow-up with a short RCA draft.
julie: thanks team. posting summary to #incidents with links to PD and runbook. :white_check_mark:"
